title: DeliveryDeploymentReceipt
description: The app-deploy producer's durable record of one dev deployment (D113), or (v0.38.0) of one review environment running an unmerged PR revision: which merged revision was deployed, which images ran, what the running app reported, which checks passed, and which earlier deployment it can be rolled back to. It is the native record behind `delivery.producer-result` for producer `app-deploy`, re-fetched through `nativeRef`. It is written when the deployment is reserved (`result: pending`) and settled in place. A settled receipt is never rewritten to a different result, except that `reconcile` may settle a `pending` one. It is never acceptance. A review receipt (`environment.name: review`) is the same record with `revisionRole: task`, a `review` block and an optional `environment.apiDocsUrl`; a dev receipt is unchanged. See `docs/task-delivery.md` §App-deploy for the lookup transport and the mapping to `delivery.producer-result`, and §Review environments for the review shape.

deploymentId.description: The producer's stable deployment id. It is `delivery.producer-result.operationId` and the id the running app reports as `observed.deploymentId`.

kind.description: `deploy`: a merged revision built and started. `rollback`: an earlier deployment's retained images started again without a rebuild. Either way it is a new deployment with its own id, observation and checks.

branch.description: Branch whose first-parent line the revision was taken from, e.g. `dev`.

mergedRevision.description: Full SHA of the revision this deployment was built from (for `kind: rollback`, the revision of the restored deployment). For a dev deployment it is the merged revision. For a review environment (`revisionRole: task`) it is the PR head, which is NOT merged; the field keeps its v0.36.0 name so dev receipts stay valid unchanged. It is known when the deployment is reserved, so it is never `null`. That the running app actually serves it is shown by `observed.revision`, not by this field.

revisionRole.description: Role of `mergedRevision`, same meaning as `delivery.evidence.revisionRole`. ABSENT means `merged` (every v0.36.0 dev receipt). `task` is required for, and only for, a review environment: the PR head, never a merged SHA.

review.title: DeliveryReviewReference
review.description: Present only for a review environment: which PR the environment was started for. The PR's head branch is the receipt's `branch`. `null` members mean the caller did not supply them (a branch-only review), never a default.

pullRequest.description: PR number in `repository`, or `null` for a branch-only review.

pullRequestUrl.description: Web URL of the PR, or `null`.

digestKind.description: What the digests are. `local-image-id`: the local container engine's image id (sha256 of the image config). It identifies the image only on the deploying host and was never pushed. `registry-manifest`: a pushed manifest digest. A rollback verifies digests of this same kind.

result.description: Same meanings as `delivery.producer-result.outcome`. `passed` only when the stack came up (exit 0) and every gating check passed. Any gating `unknown` makes the result `unknown`, never `passed`.

exitCode.description: Exit status of the deploy command (e.g. `compose up --wait`). `null` when not reported, e.g. on a timeout. It is never defaulted to 0.

observedAt.description: When `observed` and the post-deploy checks were taken. `null` only while `pending`.

name.description: `dev`: the integration-branch deployment (D113). `review`: an environment running an unmerged PR revision (v0.38.0). Production is outside this contract.

url.description: For a review environment this is the frontend URL. URL the identity observation and smoke checks were run against. A configured hostname (e.g. `http://planotell.platform.localhost`) appears here only if the identity observed through that hostname matched this deployment. Otherwise this is the URL that was actually observed, e.g. loopback.

apiDocsUrl.description: Review environments only: the API documentation (Swagger) URL, or `null` when the environment has none. Not allowed on a dev receipt.

observed.description: What the running app reported through `environment.url`, copied as-is. `null` when the identity endpoint could not be read at all (not reachable, no identity document). A reported value that differs from `mergedRevision` or `deploymentId` is kept as reported and recorded as a `failed` identity check. It is never corrected.

checks.description: Every check in the order run: pre-deploy gates (e.g. `ci:*`, `quality:*`), identity checks (`identity:*`), smoke checks (`smoke:*`), criterion checks (`criterion:<id>`, with `criterionId`) and non-gating route checks (`route:*`). This array becomes `delivery.producer-result.checks` unchanged.

correlation.description: Factory's delivery id and operation key, as passed to the deploy command. `null` members when not given.

rollback.description: The rollback identity: the most recent `passed` deployment before this one, i.e. what a rollback from here would restore. `null` when no earlier deployment passed. It is recorded when the deployment is reserved and never recomputed later.

rollbackOf.description: For `kind: rollback`: the deployment that was current when the rollback ran, i.e. the one rolled back. `null` for `kind: deploy`.

restores.description: For `kind: rollback`: the deployment whose images were restarted. `null` for `kind: deploy`.

nativeRef.description: `<repository>:deployments/<deploymentId>`, e.g. `plantpal:deployments/pla-dev-20260927120000-0123456789ab`. Identical to `delivery.producer-result.nativeRef` for this deployment.

imageDigests.title: DeliveryImageDigests
imageDigests.description: Component name → image digest (`sha256:<64 hex>`), one entry per deployed component (plantpal: `backend`, `frontend`). A value is `null` while pending, or when the image was never built or could not be inspected.

rollbackIdentity.title: DeliveryRollbackIdentity
rollbackIdentity.description: The earlier deployment a rollback restores: its id, its `mergedRevision` and its digests. A rollback refuses to start an image whose current digest differs from `imageDigests`.

deploymentId.description: The earlier deployment a rollback restores.
